name: Zendesk Employee Service
summary: Zendesk Employee Service extends Zendesk's ticketing platform to HR teams. It puts employee HR requests in one workspace, offers an AI-powered help centre for HR questions, and lets employees check the status of HR inquiries. The pricing page shows no Employee Service price.

facts.text: The HR page describes one platform for HR teams to manage all employee requests, tasks and enquiries in one workspace.
The HR page describes a searchable, AI-powered help centre for employees, and AI agents that handle routine HR questions.
Zendesk's HR help desk guide, in a section on Zendesk's own ease of use, says employees can track the status of their HR inquiries, such as paid time off requests.
The HR page offers a free trial of 14 days for the HR service management product.

plans.name: Employee Service
plans.notes: No Employee Service price is shown. The pricing page says enterprise plans generally require sales engagement. The Support Team plan, listed at US$19 per agent a month billed annually, is a customer service plan and is not the Employee Service product.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page title says 'Starting from £19/month' while its plan cards show US$ 19. The currency is unclear on that page.
